name: Mikage Jin
source:
The protagonist of the story, a ninja who serves as part of an organization related to the government, under his mother.  He was raised from birth to be a ninja, and he is a natural hard-worker.  He is all-too-aware that he is only moderately talented, and he has no illusions that hard work will always be rewarded with results.  He is quite capable and devoted to his work, and, despite his youth, has already successfully completed a number of missions.  However, he is aware, due to having several examples around him, that his abilities are not exceptional.  

He has trouble talking to women due to his lack of contact with the opposite sex in his childhood outside of those much older than himself.  In addition, he has difficulty with simply having fun and enjoying himself in areas not involved with work.
